core_obligations: Construct the maps (proof lines 11599-11603): the author obtains the two maps from the adjunction properties of the functors, namely the unit of the adjunction for the open immersion and the comparison map for the closed immersion.

Exactness (proof lines 11603-11609): the exactness is checked on stalks, where the sequence becomes the tautological sequence for the sheaf at points inside U, at points of Z and at the generic points of Z, since the stalks of the outer functors vanish on the appropriate loci.
proof_roadmap: Build the two maps from the adjunctions.
Check exactness on stalks, where the outer terms vanish on complementary loci.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the short exact sequence relating a sheaf on X_etale, its extension by zero from the open complement of a closed subscheme and the direct image of its restriction to that closed subscheme (statement lines 11587-11597, with the displayed sequence). The proof builds the two maps from the adjunction properties of the functors (proof lines 11599-11603) and checks exactness on stalks, where the outer terms vanish on complementary loci (proof lines 11603-11609). The non-formal content is the stalk computation. The claim is H2: one construction plus one stalk check.
